overridesNote: rehype-katex 7.0.1 (latest) still pins katex@^0.16.0 as its own dependency. This override forces a single katex copy so the renderer and katex/dist/katex.min.css stay in sync (katex 0.18 renamed internal CSS classes, e.g. base->katex-base). REMOVE the override once a rehype-katex release depends on katex ^0.18 or declares katex as a peerDependency — verify with: npm ls katex (want rehype-katex -> katex ... deduped). See docs/architecture.md 'KaTeX version coupling'.
